### Slow Growth Is Strong Growth
Author: Ashley Moore
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/slow-growth-the-crosswalk-devotional.html
Passage: Jeremiah 17:8
Points:
- Just like sturdy trees, deep and enduring spiritual growth often happens slowly.
- Bearing spiritual fruit requires staying consistently connected to God as the true source of living water.
- Overcoming the sinful flesh and cultivating Christlike character takes ongoing commitment to spiritual disciplines.
- Believers should take heart when growth feels slow, because slow growth builds resilient strength.

### My Two Voices
Author: John UpChurch
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/crosswalk-devo/crosswalk-the-devotional-march-12-2013.html
Passage: Jeremiah 17:9
Points:
- The human heart is naturally prone to self-deception and excuses when confronted by God's Word.
- An inner voice of self-justification often tries to dismiss biblical convictions and rationalize sin.
- Scripture acts like sandpaper against our selfish assumptions and exposes our spiritual blind spots.
- Honest confession and humble prayer help silence deceitful self-justification and surrender the heart to God.
